---
// Canary for the raw-HTML ban (tests/quality.test.mjs). Named .txt so astro check and the build never load it.
const { item } = Astro.props;
---
<p set:html={item.title} />
<script>
  document.querySelector('p').innerHTML = location.hash;
  document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', location.search);
  document.write(document.referrer);
</script>
